contracts.contract_plain_english: In a one-dimensional scalar constant-coefficient setting, the contaminant advection PDE q_t + u_bar q_x = 0 and the right-going one-way sound-wave PDE w_t + c w_x = 0 have exactly the same mathematical form once q is renamed w and u_bar is renamed c. Their physical meanings remain different, and the right-going acoustic interpretation explicitly has c > 0. The source uses the shared form to motivate similar mathematical and numerical treatment; it does not identify the physical quantities or promise that every method transfers.

contracts.contract_plain_english: For a sound wave traveling to the right in one spatial dimension at positive sound speed c, an appropriate scalar combination w of pressure and particle velocity is modeled by w_t + c w_x = 0. The equation is scalar, first-order, constant-coefficient, and hyperbolic; it is called one-way because it isolates propagation in one direction. The plus sign together with c > 0 gives rightward motion, with translated profiles depending on x - c t. The cited passage leaves the generic formula for w and the exact regularity, initial, and boundary assumptions unstated, and it does not present an exhaustive physical or solution classification.
